name: Obsidian
author: tidedeck
description: Read, search and edit notes in your Obsidian vault.

panel.description: Read the current note; type to find another, e to edit.

schema.label: vault
schema.description: Which vault to read. The list is read from Obsidian.

schema.label: search
schema.description: What is typed in the pane; it filters the notes as you type.

schema.label: new note folder
schema.description: Where a new note is created, relative to the vault. Blank is the vault root.

schema.label: editor mode
schema.description: Ripple's editing mode for editing a note.
